text:
It is summer in the northern hemisphere of the Earth in June.
Which statement explains why?
A
The Earth is closer to the Sun in June.
B
The Earth spins on its axis in the opposite direction to that in which it rotates around the Sun.
C
The Moon is full in June.
D
The north pole of the axis of the Earth’s rotation is tilted towards the Sun in June.

options.label: A
options.text: The Earth is closer to the Sun in June.

options.label: B
options.text: The Earth spins on its axis in the opposite direction to that in which it rotates around the Sun.

options.label: C
options.text: The Moon is full in June.

options.label: D
options.text: The north pole of the axis of the Earth’s rotation is tilted towards the Sun in June.
